description: This file defines a PHP class 'Permission' within the OpenCart framework, specifically for the admin error handling controller related to permission errors. It generates a 401 Unauthorized response with appropriate breadcrumbs and loads common header, footer, and layout components for the permission error page.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Controller class for handling permission error pages, extending the core Controller class in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to generate the permission error page, sets headers, breadcrumbs, loads page components, and outputs the view.
